comparisonScope: The engine compares bounded selected-source/state fields, core playback events, forbidden reselection events, early cursor/rate preservation, and Promise outcomes/order. PCM wall-clock time, decoder readiness/task event timing, full media-task discard and every immediate network transition are raw evidence only. Same-task source insertion reports immediate NETWORK_LOADING in Chromium; the target compares its settled network and immediate pending promise/cursor/rate. Cross-live-realm removal checks only original handle pause suppression, not complete shared media-state transfer.
